paragraphs.text: Pontotoc’s girls are listed third in Class 5A with 87 points in Saturday’s state cross-country team results posted by Pirate Timing on MileSplit Live. The Oct. 31 meet took place at Mississippi College’s Choctaw Trails Watson Cross Country Course.
The Warriors’ boys are listed sixth in Class 5A with 145 points. Brookhaven led the girls’ team standings with 41 points, while Caledonia topped the boys’ table with 29.
North Pontotoc is listed seventh in both Class 4A races. The Vikings’ girls scored 230 points and the boys scored 222 in the posted team standings.

South Pontotoc’s girls are listed ninth in Class 4A with 259 points, and the Cougars’ boys are twelfth with 321. The linked tables provide the timing provider’s scored team results as checked Saturday afternoon.
